purpose: City-specific official registry/cadastre and safe anonymous parcel-geometry discovery.
assessment: Official primary pages identify an active land-allocation and title workflow for Oyo Town GRA and aggregate Land Use Charge records for Oyo West and Oyo East. This establishes a city-local property-record service; the broader OyoGISS point/address description is not treated as cadastral polygon coverage. No personal property search was made.
registryAssessment: City-local evidence is explicit: the Oyo State Ministry of Lands lists an implemented “Oyo Town GRA, Oyo” land-allocation service, with plot selection, allocation letter and Certificate of Occupancy workflow; its current Land Use Charge table separately lists Oyo West and Oyo East property records. This supports a local government property-record/land service for Oyo town, distinct from Ibadan and the state namesake. It does not establish a general citywide cadastral polygon layer, exact WUP-locator jurisdiction, or anonymous parcel geometry.
